title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard
method: Retains WorkPass 7 fixed weights; updates only workstreams whose implementation evidence changed. This is estimated weighted implementation progress, not release readiness. Task counts use the normalized, non-duplicated inventory, not append-only historical tasklist rows.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: No duplicate canonical owner; source manifests and metadata contract reconciled.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass16 makes browser smoke fail closed on required brand warnings and actual auth mismatch, exposes indeterminate auth state, validates bounded timeouts, and atomically publishes private verdict files. The 212/212 source-only UI script suite passes; dependency-complete UI build and actual browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: Retrieval determinism, complete fingerprints, offline runner and confidence gates are implemented; real labeled temporal holdout is still absent.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass17 had query-unbound HTTPS research preflight; WorkPass18 implements bounded DNS-pinned HTTPS fetch, public-address rejection, per-hop redirect checks, query fingerprinting and a lexical relevance gate that attenuates EvidenceFirewall confidence. Thirteen async transport regressions and firewall tests pass. Live DNS/provider is unavailable in the sandbox; semantic entailment and browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: Experiment infrastructure is stronger, but no real-corpus uplift or research promotion is evidenced.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Version/metadata and archive evidence improved; app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room drill and soak remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Normalized unique deliverables, not append-only tasklist line counts. PARTIAL is not always exactly half-complete; half-credit is a comparison aid.

environmentNote: WorkPass18 adds real bounded HTTPS transport with DNS pinning, per-hop allowlist/DNS validation, query hashing and a lexical relevance gate. Runtime tsc and project-research suites pass. A live probe returned dns-resolution-failed in this sandbox, so no live-provider evidence promotion is claimed. limitations: No real independently labeled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout; synthetic fixture proves harness behavior only.
Full agency chain from ActionCompetition through external receipt, persistence, reafference and UI remains partially covered.
Full app dependency installation, root/app semantic typecheck, React/Vite production build and desktop/mobile browser E2E remain open.
Clean-room install/restore/upgrade/rollback, multi-hour soak, provider reconnect/remote-postcondition stress and final SBOM/provenance sign-off remain open.
Full app dependency installation, semantic app typecheck, React/Vite build and Playwright browser E2E remain blocked/unverified in the current environment.
Brand and auth smoke gate behavior is unit-tested, but not executed against a running Chromium app in this pass.
Direct app typecheck fails with TS2688 for missing @types/node and vite/client; production build fails because vite executable is absent (spawn vite ENOENT).
WorkPass18 lexical topicality is not semantic entailment: query-term matching cannot prove that retrieved content supports the target claim.
A real external provider run on two allowed hosts could not be completed because DNS resolution failed in the current sandbox.
No real independently labeled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout; synthetic fixtures prove harness behavior only.
Full app dependency installation, React/Vite production build and desktop/mobile/Live2D browser E2E remain open.
